format: White RGBA stamp; transparent black; 1024 square; non-tileable
productionPrompt: Create a pristine white heraldic armor stamp: SUBJECT. One emblem centered in a square canvas with a 10% clear margin. Flat solid white shapes, with large clean transparent negative-space cutouts defining every detail. Graphic stencil style, NOT a shaded drawing or engraving illustration. Use strong smooth outlines and generously wide gaps (at least 8 pixels at 1024 resolution). Avoid tiny lines, shading, texture, grunge, distress, speckling, scratches, or paper. White foreground, transparent black background (RGBA 0,0,0,0), including the internal holes. Actual transparent PNG alpha. No text, labels, sheet, border, or watermark. The stencil should be elegant and detailed but every detail must be a bold deliberate cutout, not a thin black line. Square 1024x1024.
notes: Prompts were refined during generation. Alpha cleanup and corner symmetry were applied after generation.
